text: 在10月29—30日举办的2026全球华人汽车精英联合年会暨“中国拥抱世界”汽车产业国际发展论坛上，罗兰贝格（巴黎）公司合伙人Eric Esperance预测，2030年中国车企在欧洲销量将达270万辆，其中37%实现本土生产，产能将通过绿地投资与盘活欧洲闲置产能双路径推进。针对汽车供应链企业出海布局，他建议中国车企可采取跟随核心客户合资共建、逐步拓展欧洲本土客户群等阶梯式落地路径，同时提示企业需正视中欧商业文化在决策节奏、沟通逻辑与工作理念上的核心差异。他强调，欧盟关税政策与本地化含量规则已构成实质性结构性压力，推进深度本地化运营，是中国车企在欧洲市场
text_en: At the 2026 Global Chinese Automotive Elites Joint Annual Conference and the "China Embraces the World" International Automotive Industry Development Forum held on October 29-30, Eric Esperance, a partner at Roland Berger (Paris), predicted that Chinese automakers' sales in Europe will reach 2.7 million vehicles by 2030, with 37% produced locally, and capacity will be advanced through both greenfield investment and revitalizing idle European capacity. Regarding the overseas expansion of automotive supply chain companies, he suggested that Chinese automakers adopt a phased approach, such as forming joint ventures with core customers and gradually expanding their European local customer base, while noting that companies must confront core differences in Sino-European business culture regarding decision-making pace, communication logic and work philosophy. He stressed that EU tariff policies and local content rules have created substantial structural pressure, and that advancing deep localized operations is what Chinese automakers need in the European market.
